TA REMAINDER LOCK v036: Realistic illustrated cinematic desert-colony caper; dimensional natural faces and material detail, not Disney or photoreal live action. Approved direct character references govern identity; Harper retains her established short hair and outfit; Taffy is portly with full cheeks and large rounded ears. Humanoid hands have four fingers plus one thumb and natural wrists. Scrapper is kind beaked ant alien with four arms, two bare clawed legs, metallic-knit sleeveless top, separate teal wrap and canvas powered-tool belt. Private guards wear cream uniforms and cobalt armor. Ship is the approved broad ivory/teal Harrier motorhome, stubby wings, one fin, four side vector nozzles, fixed recessed forward nose radar and missing machinery covers. No external radar dish or pre-Harrier twin engine pods. Clean landscape16:9 single starter frame, no titles, borders, rulers, readable Earth text or montage. Depict the setup just before action; all necessary visible participants and props already present, no duplicated characters or future outcomes prematurely enacted. END LOCK.
Use case: illustration-story. Reference images are identity/style/geometry authorities, not a collage or pose template. Interior powered but still parked in dark salvage bay. Camera from just ahead of cockpit facing aft as reverse cockpit ref. Harper standing between left edge and seats, one hand gripping overhead rail, alert and braced; Taffy seated in right of image at controls, short portly child fitting naturally in large adult seat, struggling to maintain test. Slight worried determined expression, no motion blur. Foreground edge of cockpit display beginning to show amber bulletin icon, cabin lamps on. Dark junk visible through hatch, not bright day or flying sky. Setup before shudder and bulletin interruption. Hands clearly anatomically natural. Wide enough to retain cabin geography.
Only TWO characters in this image: Harper and Taffy. No scrapper, guards or any other figures. Cabin rear bulkhead closed, no rear open ramp. Keep exact reverse cockpit layout of reference.

qa.notes: Second attempt removed unrequested alien and restored closed aft bulkhead. Two actors only, natural braced rail/control grips. Powered lights, salvage exterior.
qa.starterIntent: Setup before primary shot action; preserve forward motion in video direction.
